        store_type,
        AVG(district_manager_hours_spent) as avg_hours_month1
    FROM store_metrics
    WHERE year = 2024 AND month = 1
    GROUP BY store_type
),
month3_data AS (
    SELECT 
        store_type,
        AVG(district_manager_hours_spent) as avg_hours_month3
    FROM store_metrics
    WHERE year = 2024 AND month = 3
    GROUP BY store_type
)
SELECT 
    m1.store_type,
    m1.avg_hours_month1,
    m3.avg_hours_month3,
    (m3.avg_hours_month3 - m1.avg_hours_month1) as hours_increase,
    ROUND(((m3.avg_hours_month3 - m1.avg_hours_month1) / NULLIF(m1.avg_hours_month1, 0) * 100), 2) as percent_increase
FROM month1_data m1
JOIN month3_data m3 ON m1.store_type = m3.store_type
ORDER BY hours_increase DESC

history.sqlQuery:
WITH monthly_patterns AS (
  -- Calculate monthly order patterns for each store
  SELECT 
    store_name,
    store_type,
    month,
    SUM(order_month) as monthly_orders
  FROM store_metrics
  WHERE year = 2024
  GROUP BY store_name, store_type, month
),
store_type_patterns AS (
  -- Calculate average monthly pattern for each store type
  SELECT 
    store_type,
    month,
    AVG(order_month) as avg_orders_for_type,
    STDDEV(order_month) as stddev_orders_for_type
  FROM store_metrics
  WHERE year = 2024
  GROUP BY store_type, month
),
seasonality_scores AS (
  -- Calculate how closely each store follows its store type's pattern
  SELECT 
    mp.store_name,
    mp.store_type,
    -- Calculate correlation between store's pattern and store type's average pattern
    CORR(mp.monthly_orders, stp.avg_orders_for_type) as seasonality_correlation,
    -- Calculate average deviation from expected pattern
    AVG(ABS(mp.monthly_orders - stp.avg_orders_for_type) / NULLIF(stp.stddev_orders_for_type, 0)) as avg_deviation_score
  FROM monthly_patterns mp
  JOIN store_type_patterns stp 
    ON mp.store_type = stp.store_type 
    AND mp.month = stp.month
  GROUP BY mp.store_name, mp.store_type
)
SELECT 
  store_name,
  store_type,
  seasonality_correlation,
  avg_deviation_score,
  CASE 
    WHEN seasonality_correlation > 0.8 AND avg_deviation_score < 1.5 THEN 'Strong Match'
    WHEN seasonality_correlation > 0.6 AND avg_deviation_score < 2.0 THEN 'Good Match'
    WHEN seasonality_correlation > 0.4 THEN 'Moderate Match'
    ELSE 'Weak Match'
  END as pattern_match_level
FROM seasonality_scores
WHERE seasonality_correlation > 0.6  -- Shows expected seasonality
ORDER BY seasonality_correlation DESC
LIMIT 100
